content.title: Creative contribution and paired reflection
content.summary: Two invited people race to contribute one canonical story piece.
content.setup: Shuffle once. Invite two people with one shared 24-hour deadline. The host launches successors from the saved queue and actual accepted contribution.
content.participant: If invited, submit one complete text or image. The first valid accepted contribution becomes canonical. Decline if you prefer to pass.
content.completion: The winner moves back; the losing invitee moves to the front for a fresh shared window. If both expire, rotate them; pause after a full failed pass.
content.access: Canonical contributions are attributed and visible to bound participants. Media references require host authority; queue membership gives no new access.

provenance.rights: Authors retain rights to their contributions; this definition grants no media rights.

steps.prompt: Add a text or image to the shared story.
Reflect privately with your partner on the accepted piece.
